name: Dissection Tools
oracleText:
When this Equipment enters, manifest dread, then attach this Equipment to that creature. (To manifest dread, look at the top two cards of your library. Put one onto the battlefield face down as a 2/2 creature and the other into your graveyard. Turn it face up any time for its mana cost if it's a creature card.)
Equipped creature gets +2/+2 and has deathtouch and lifelink.
Equip—Sacrifice a creature.
